title: What Happens If You Hold Your Pee Too Long?
sources: Cleveland Clinic, 'Bladder' (holds 500-700 mL, about two cups; expands like a balloon; when it fills with 200-350 mL, nerves in the bladder tell your brain to use the toilet): https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/body/25010-bladder

NIDDK (NIH), 'The Urinary Tract & How It Works' (bladder holds 1.5 to 2 cups; two sets of sphincter muscles keep urine in; holding urine too long can weaken bladder muscles and make it harder to empty completely; urine left in the bladder lets bacteria grow, raising the risk of a urinary tract infection): https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/urologic-diseases/urinary-tract-how-it-works

Cleveland Clinic, 'Urinary Retention' (pee that stays in the bladder can overstretch and damage bladder muscles; if you can't pee at all, seek care right away): https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/15427-urinary-retention

ColumbiaDoctors (Columbia University urology), 'Can Your Bladder Burst From Holding Your Urine?' (spontaneous bladder rupture is possible but rare and limited to case reports; the discomfort becomes intense enough that a person seeks out a restroom; habitual holding can overstretch the bladder): https://www.columbiadoctors.org/news/can-your-bladder-burst-holding-your-urine

Harvard Health Publishing, 'Can your bladder burst from holding it too long?' (bladder is unlikely to rupture just because you held it; holding could let bacteria multiply and stretch the bladder): https://www.health.harvard.edu/staying-healthy/you-dont-say-can-your-bladder-burst-from-holding-it-too-long

Tease (next video): NIH PMC review 'Lichtenberg figures: morphological findings' (fern-like skin patterns after lightning strikes, not burns, fade within hours in survivors): https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10329080/

lines.text: What happens if you hold your pee too long?
Your stretchy bladder holds about two cups.
But can it actually pop? Hold that thought.
By one cup, nerves in the wall ping your brain,
while two ring muscles clamp the exit shut.
Hold it all the time, and bacteria can grow in the waiting pee,
lines.caps: *HOLD IT | ALL THE *TIME | AND *BACTERIA | CAN *GROW | IN THE *WAITING PEE

lines.text: raising your risk of a urinary tract infection.
Over time, the overstretched muscle can weaken and struggle to empty.
lines.caps: OVER *TIME | THE *OVERSTRETCHED | MUSCLE CAN *WEAKEN | AND *STRUGGLE | TO *EMPTY

lines.text: So, can it pop? In a healthy bladder, it's incredibly rare.
lines.caps: SO, CAN IT *POP? | IN A *HEALTHY | *BLADDER | IT'S *INCREDIBLY | *RARE

lines.text: The urge gets so intense you sprint for a toilet first.
